description: Unit tests for the TalkPromptBuilder class in the OpenClawKit project, verifying prompt construction based on transcript text, interruption timing, and optional voice directive hints.
external_methods: TalkPromptBuilder.build(transcript: String, interruptedAtSeconds: Double?, includeVoiceDirectiveHint: Bool)

classes.name: TalkPromptBuilderTests
classes.description: Test case class for the TalkPromptBuilder, contains multiple test methods to verify prompt generation.

methods.name: testBuildIncludesTranscript

methods.description: Checks that the prompt includes an interruption timing message when specified.
